SIMPLE ENGLISH
Reflog records local ref updates and can help recover recently unreachable commits. Entries
expire and are not a remote backup.

git reflog --oneline
git show <recovered-id>
git branch rescue <recovered-id>
Expected: The rescue branch makes the identified commit reachable again, if the object remains.
Is reflog a permanent backup? No, it is local and subject to expiration and garbage collection.
